title: POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap
text:
POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap

['From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Delgado <sofia@acmeai.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap

Hi Sofia / Ethan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the ingest:

Summary of what we heard
- POC goal: show 15–25% improvement in downstream answer accuracy for intent extraction and entity normalization vs. current rules baseline on a 5k prompt holdout set.
- Data available: ~12k anonymized user prompts, 200 labeled intent examples, and a subset of conversation logs (redacted).
- Success metric: macro F1 on intent + entity span exact-match; target >= 0.75 for intents.

Immediate asks (what we need from Acme)
1) Share a 500–1,000 sample of typical user prompts (anonymized) so we can validate tokenization and prompt length distribution. Prefer newline-delimited JSON or CSV.
2) Provide any existing labeling schema (intent list + entity types) and a few labeled examples.
3) Confirm PII redaction steps and a contact for security/compliance questions.

Redwood proposal (high level)
- Ingest & validation: we’ll run a quick schema check and token-length profile within 48 hours of sample receipt.
- Eval harness: we’ll build an eval with the provided labeled examples plus a small human-review buffer.
- Timeline: sample intake (this week), initial ingest & analysis (2 business days), first-run eval (3 business days), sync to discuss results and next steps.

Owners (who does what)
- Acme: Sofia (data drop + label schema), Ethan (security contact)
- Redwood: Alex (POC lead & test plan), Monica (prompt normalization & ingest), Rishi (eval harness & metrics)

Next meeting
- Tentative: Thu 2027-10-14 11:00 PT for a 30m sync to review sample profile and confirm success criteria. Please confirm or propose another time.

Attachments: sample file spec (see inline), quick eval template attached.

Thanks — looking forward to the sample.

—
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
', 'From: Sofia Delgado <sofia@acmeai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@acmeai.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap

Alex —

Appreciate the clear summary. We attached a 750-sample export (acme_user_prompts_sample.json) to the S3 path below and gave your team read access. The file is newline JSON; fields: user_id (hashed), prompt_text, session_id, timestamp, channel.

Security notes:
- All user IDs are hashed; we removed email/phone fields.
- We have a separate labeled set of 220 intents (small.csv) — Ethan will share that link to your inbox in a moment.

Link: s3://acmeai-shared/prompt-samples/2027-10-12/user_prompts_sample.json

Questions from our side:
1) For the ingest, do you normalize punctuation and whitespace? We want to preserve original utterances for A/B analysis.
2) Will you keep a copy in your private tenant for the trial? Need to confirm retention window.

Ethan or I can join the Thu sync. Thanks — look forward to the first-pass analysis.

Attachments: acme_user_prompts_sample.json (s3 link); small.csv (label schema)

Best,
Sofia Delgado
Head of Data Platform | AcmeAI
sofia@acmeai.com
', "From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Delgado <sofia@acmeai.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap

Thanks Sofia — received and confirmed read access to the S3 path. Quick answers and a short mutual action plan embedded below.

QA answers:
- Ingest normalization: by default we do light normalization (trim, fix whitespace, normalize Unicode). We will NOT alter punctuation or rewrite user text unless you request canonicalization; we’ll keep originals in a raw bucket and work copies in a processing bucket.
- Retention: for Redwood Private trials we default to a 30-day retention in your private tenant; we can extend to 90 days under a short agreement. Please confirm your preference.

Mutual action plan (MAP) — milestones and owners
1) Data intake: Acme drops full sample and label schema (Sofia) — Done.
2) Ingest & profile: Redwood runs tokenization, length distribution, and simple label coverage checks (Monica) — ETA: Thu EOD PT.
3) Eval harness & baseline run: Redwood builds eval harness; runs on 1k sample + available labels (Rishi) — ETA: Mon Oct 18 15:00 PT.
4) Results sync & success criteria sign-off: joint call to review metrics vs. target (all) — Tentative: Tue Oct 19 11:00 PT.

Open items for Acme to confirm
- Retention window (30 vs. 90 days)
- Which 3 intents are highest priority for the first pass? (we'll prioritize labeling balance)

Attachments included: redwood_mop_local_eval_template.md (eval checklist & metric defs).

See you on Thu — I’ll send calendar invites after you confirm retention and priority intents.

—
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
", 'From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: POC onboarding: prompt/log ingest & evaluation roadmap

Monica / Rishi — forwarding the thread and S3 path. Actions for our side:
- Monica: run the schema & token profile sweep today; attach a short report (token length histogram + top 20 tokens) to the MAP doc.
- Rishi: start templating the eval harness using the attached MOP template and prioritize intent F1 as the primary metric. Pull 1k random samples from the 750 file + request an additional 300 samples if needed.

Retention question: default 30 days — if Acme wants 90 we’ll need an extension note in the trial agreement. If they ask, I’ll loop legal.

I scheduled internal checkpoints: Mon Oct 18 09:30 PT (ingest status), Mon Oct 18 16:00 PT (first eval run check). Please flag blockers early.

—
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
